spec.prompt: The same shot continues from the first frame: a symmetrical face-off in the knee-deep red-brown shallows, the Lydian on the left in profile facing right (crested bronze helmet, crimson tunic, bronze scale corselet, round crimson lion shield, spear) and the Mede on the right in profile facing left (red felt cap, black beard, ochre tunic, iron scale corselet, round wicker shield, spear), exactly centred and mirrored, shields up, spear points lowered toward each other; they step slowly sideways, circling, eyes locked, and do not strike. Behind them, on the gravel bank across the water, the two lines fight from the first second: Lydians (crested helmets, crimson tunics, lion shields) and Medes (red caps, ochre tunics, wicker shields) clash all along the bank, spears thrusting, shields slamming, men falling, dust kicked up; the melee fills the whole width of the far bank. Camera static. Low golden sun at frame right, long shadows, clear air. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. No blood. No stirrups, no flags, no modern objects. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: S25 v2: P15's mirrored face-off, now with the melee raging on the shore behind them.
